quotes.title: IRAS 04125+2902
quotes.card: IRAS 04125+2902 is an M-type star and a T Tauri variable located in the Taurus Molecular Cloud, 160 parsecs from Earth.
quotes.introduction: This young protostar has 70% of the Sun's mass, 1.45 times the Sun's radius and an effective temperature of 4,080 K. It has a very young age of three million years.
